name: Todoroke Seiki no Daihatsumei: Ai to Ikari to Kanashimi no Himitsu Kessha Dai Ni Kagakubu
original_name: 轟け性紀の大発明 愛と怒りと悲しみの秘密結社第二科学部
source:
With the cherry blossoms of spring in full bloom, how is everybody spending these vivid and colorful days?

On this occasion, I wish to declare to everybody the formation of the "Second Science Club".

During today's morning assembly, I had heard that Hanabatake Academy's esteemed science club would be established once more, and certainly, without fail, I felt I would be chosen as advisor without anyone raising an objection.

But in reality?

Despite being a genius inventor, I was slighted for the position by a quack who joked about things like dripping unknown liquids on potatoes.
「Look, it's turning purple now~」
And this was declared without any error?... No, it was certainly an error!!

Haa... haa... It appears that I was a bit too forceful with that writing brush. Please excuse my sudden loss of composure.

Well, given the circumstances, I would like to establish the Secret Society of Evil, the "Second Science Club".

Alongside my super, ultra-hyper, idiotic subordinate, or rather my subordinate, Haruhara Fuuka, and my super ultra-awesome inventions, I request your support in seeking revenge against this academy. 

With that said, I wish everyone a wonderful school life...

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?aflg=18over&product_code=57&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
春日樱花烂漫，大家正在怎样度过这色彩鲜明的日子呢？

值此良机，我要向各位宣布“第二科学部”正式成立。

今天晨会上，我听说花畑学园引以为豪的科学部即将重新成立。我原本确信自己一定会在无人反对的情况下当选顾问。

可现实如何？

我明明是个天才发明家，顾问职位却被一个庸医抢走。那家伙只会开些把不明液体滴到土豆上的玩笑。
“快看，现在变成紫色啦～”
这种决定竟被宣布为正确无误？…不，这显然就是个错误！！

呼…呼…看来刚才挥动毛笔时有些太用力了。请原谅我突然失态。

总之，事已至此，我决定成立邪恶秘密结社——“第二科学部”。

我会与超级、究极、无可救药的笨蛋部下——不，部下春原风花——以及我的超级究极伟大发明一起，向这所学园展开复仇，还请各位多多支持。

那么，祝大家拥有愉快的校园生活…
